images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. A 2D action-drawing game underwater: teal-green shallow sea with slanted god rays, drifting marine snow, dark kelp and cliff silhouettes. A small vivid orange-red octopus with curling spotted tentacles swims inside a huge black sumi-e ink drawing it is painting: the outline of a giant fish with a forked tail, dorsal fin, gill line, round eye and mouth, drawn with bristly calligraphic brush strokes, dry-brush streaks, splatter droplets and soft bleeding halos. From the right a realistic grey-blue shark approaches, a faint orange perception cone reaching toward the drawing, with a dark tooltip '상어의 눈' and a meter nearly hitting a '도망 70%' threshold. HUD: top-left bold serif title '먹물 문어', top-right an ink-sac gauge '먹물 주머니 46%', a vertical depth scale at '−140m', a small timer pill '먹물 번짐까지', bottom-left predator card '청상아리' explaining it is fooled by a bigger fish, bottom-center round brush tool buttons. Painterly, teal and black with orange accent, subtle grain.

Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Deep-sea abyss scene of a 2D action-drawing game, almost black navy water with violet and cyan bioluminescent plankton. On the right a large dark anglerfish with needle teeth and a glowing cyan lure dangling on a curved stalk; the lure casts the only light. On the left a large black ink-painted boulder with brushy outlines and crack strokes, its edge rim-lit cyan by the lure, and the tips of a small dark red octopus's tentacles peek out from behind it, one eye glinting. A swirl of stirred purple plankton circles the rock. Big outlined serif stamp text tilted at upper left: '속았다' with the subtitle '아귀가 먹물 바위를 지나친다'. Bottom-left thin large depth readout '−930m'. Bottom-right a dark violet card '포식자 도감 · 새 항목' with rows '초롱아귀 — 바위로 착각', '그림 정확도 91%', '남은 먹물 12%'. Moody, high-contrast, glowing, fine grain.
